user.title: Z2M Device Tracker
user.description: Connects to the Z2M Device Tracker app, which records every Zigbee2MQTT device's history. Adds summary sensors and the z2m-tracker-card. The app URL is filled in automatically when the app is installed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Z2M Device Tracker is already set up.

data_description.repairs: Mirrors the app's warnings and the checks set to notify. Each one clears itself when the problem is fixed.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Ask the app to re-scan Z2M databases, configuration backups, logs and Home Assistant registries for devices and names, and merge them into the history.

battery_replaced.name: Battery replaced
battery_replaced.description: Record a battery change for a Zigbee device. Also updates Battery Notes when it tracks the device.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Zigbee2MQTT device. Pick it by name.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Use instead of a device, for example 0x00158d0001a2b3c4.

date.name: Date
date.description: When the battery was changed. Leave empty for today.

battery_type.name: Battery type
battery_type.description: Saves the battery type for this device, for example CR2032. Leave empty to keep the current one.

mute_device.name: Mute device
mute_device.description: Stop the tracker flagging problems with a Zigbee device.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Zigbee2MQTT device. Pick it by name.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Use instead of a device, for example 0x00158d0001a2b3c4.

checks.name: Checks
checks.description: Which checks to mute. Leave empty to mute all of them.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to mute for. Leave empty to mute until you unmute it in the app.

run_network_scan.name: Run network scan
run_network_scan.description: Start a routing scan (network map) in Zigbee2MQTT. It runs in the background and can take a few minutes.

base_topic.name: Base topic
base_topic.description: The Zigbee2MQTT network to scan, for example zigbee2mqtt. Leave empty to scan every network.

reconfigure.name: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Ask Zigbee2MQTT to reconfigure a device. This re-creates its reporting bindings. Wake battery devices first.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Zigbee2MQTT device. Pick it by name.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Use instead of a device, for example 0x00158d0001a2b3c4.

ota_update.name: Firmware update
ota_update.description: Start a firmware (OTA) update. Leave the device empty to update every device that has an update available.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Zigbee2MQTT device. Leave empty to update all devices with an update.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Use instead of a device, for example 0x00158d0001a2b3c4.

pause_alerts.name: Pause alerts
pause_alerts.description: Stop the tracker sending alerts for a while, for example during Zigbee2MQTT work. Health still lists issues. When the pause ends, issues that are still there are sent once.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to pause for. Leave empty to pause until you resume.

resume_alerts.name: Resume alerts
resume_alerts.description: End a pause now. Issues found during the pause that are still there are sent.

add_note.name: Add note
add_note.description: Add a line to a Zigbee device's note in the tracker.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Zigbee2MQTT device. Pick it by name.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Use instead of a device, for example 0x00158d0001a2b3c4.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to add. It goes on a new line after the existing note.

init.title: {name}: {title}

menu_options.bindings_removed: The binding was removed on purpose
menu_options.mute_forever: Mute this check until I unmute it

restore_binding.title: Restore the binding
